brief: Disclosures for vTv Therapeutics trial NCT03980730 (Elevage, azeliragon in mild Alzheimer's disease with impaired glucose tolerance, phase 2, terminated; registry reason 'for business reasons'; primary completion 2020-12-01, completion 2021-01-29). Find what vTv told investors in 8-Ks about this trial near when it stopped. Quote the 8-K language exactly and say whether it gives a reason.

findings.claim: In an 8-K filed on November 5, 2020 (accession 0001564590-20-051429), vTv Therapeutics reported on the progress of the Elevage study, stating "Following our decision to conclude enrollment in the Elevage Study at the end of September, we look forward to announcing topline results from this phase 2 study of azeliragon in December". This passage names the trial and gives no reason for concluding enrollment.
findings.notes: Mentions conclusion of enrollment at the end of September 2020.

findings.claim: In an 8-K filed on November 24, 2020 (accession 0001564590-20-055077), vTv Therapeutics stated it intends to use net proceeds from a transaction "to support its clinical development strategy, including finalizing and reporting topline results from the Company’s ongoing Elevage Study of azeliragon for the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease in patients with type 2 diabetes in December 2020". This passage names the trial and gives no reason for stopping or concluding the trial.
findings.notes: Discusses use of proceeds to support clinical development strategy including the Elevage study.

findings.claim: In an 8-K filed on February 24, 2021 (accession 0001564590-21-008154), vTv Therapeutics announced "On December 15, 2020, vTv announced that the phase 2 Elevage Study of azeliragon did not meet its primary objective. vTv has discontinued development of azeliragon for Alzheimer’s disease". This passage names the trial and gives efficacy as the reason (did not meet its primary objective).
findings.notes: Filing states the trial did not meet its primary objective, which is an efficacy reason, contrasting with the registry reason 'for business reasons'.
